text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq to receive the first Syrian trade mission since the closure of the border between the two Arab states in the 1980s.
- Kuwait Stock Exchange index falls 7.8 points to 2,332.1.
- Parliament to debate government privatisation programme.
- National Bank of Kuwait (NBK) signs an agreement to manage a 20-million-dinar ($66 million) bond issue on behalf of Kuwait Real Estate Bank.
- Russia's Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov receives message from Kuwait's acting prime minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Sabah al-Ahmad al-Sabah.
- Kuwait grants citizenship to 20,000 women married to Kuwaitis, another 30,000 applications are under consideration, said Interior Minister Sheikh Mohammad Khaled al-Sabah.

- Kuwaiti laywers to tackle the issue of Kuwaiti POWs at an Arab lawyers' meeting in Tunisia. Kuwait accuses Iraq of detaining some 600 people, mainly Kuwaitis, missing since the 1990-91 Iraqi occupation of the Gulf Arab state.
- Kuwait seeks Russian help to free Kuwaitis held in Iraq.
